info.name: CampusHub API 全量回归（Apifox 导入）
info.description: 覆盖全部接口与关键边界。执行前先 db/init-db.bat 重置种子库。

exec: pm.test("包含新发布商品", () => { const id = Number(pm.collectionVariables.get("itemA")); pm.expect(body.data.list.some(i => i.id === id)).to.eql(true); });

item.name: 买家接受自己的出价被拒

exec: const itemId = Number(pm.collectionVariables.get("itemA")); const deal = body.data.list.find(d => d.itemId === itemId); pm.test("找到交易单", () => pm.expect(deal).to.not.be.undefined); if (deal) pm.collectionVariables.set("dealA", deal.id);

item.name: 已取消交易单私聊只读

exec: const itemId = Number(pm.collectionVariables.get("itemC")); const deal = body.data.list.find(d => d.itemId === itemId); pm.test("找到预约交易单", () => pm.expect(deal).to.not.be.undefined); if (deal) pm.collectionVariables.set("dealC", deal.id);
